scope: Profiles, projects, watches, push endpoints, logs, uploads, analytics; purpose, retention, delete/export behavior. Covered by issue #431 (dependency #37 closed).
retention_review_gate: Privacy gate before Public Beta (#40): a human reviewer must accept retention periods and residual risks. Proposed values are marked proposed_pre_beta.

categories.purpose: Applicant identity, type and geography for eligibility matching (CZ-NACE, IČO, municipality).
categories.retention: proposed_pre_beta: retained until the data subject requests deletion; export/deletion requested via privacy contact. Deleted 30 days after last account activity only on explicit user request.
categories.delete_export: User-initiated. Export via account data export; deletion via account deletion (cascades to applicant_attribute_values).
categories.fail_closed: Profile data is never inferred from third-party providers without explicit user action; UNKNOWN attribute verification_status does not block eligibility (UNKNOWN != FAIL, see ELIGIBILITY invariants).

categories.purpose: User's grant intent and application parameters for matching, readiness and workspace assistance.
categories.retention: proposed_pre_beta: retained until the data subject requests project deletion; no scheduled automatic purging of user intent. Exportable in full by the project owner.
categories.delete_export: Owner capability gate. Export: GET via /projects (owner-scoped). Delete: DELETE /projects (in roadmap). natural_language_intent is free text and may contain PII; treated as user-supplied and never sent to AI providers without explicit purpose (see PRIVACY.md AI section).
categories.fail_closed: Project text never becomes a canonical fact about a grant; only used for the owning user's matching. A project with no owner_user_id defaults to anonymous:{projectId} and remains manageable via its capability token.

categories.purpose: Grant change monitoring and notification triggering scoped to a project or user interest.
categories.retention: proposed_pre_beta: retained until owner deletes the watch (DELETE /projects/:id/watch). watch_matches cascade on watch deletion.
categories.delete_export: Deleted with the parent project watch. filter_json may contain search intent; treated as user-controlled.
categories.fail_closed: A disabled or revoked watch produces no notifications. Watches require project owner capability; no public watch listing exists.

categories.purpose: Push subscription endpoints for web push notifications.
categories.retention: proposed_pre_beta: retained until user unsubscribes / revokes. endpoint/auth keys are encrypted at rest (ciphertext), never stored in plaintext.
categories.delete_export: Revoked on unsubscribe (revoked_at set). Inactive revoked rows retained 30 days then purged. user_id links to identity, not to project text.
categories.fail_closed: Push is opt-in and rate-limited. A failed or disabled push subscription falls back to in-app notification silently (see NOTIFICATIONS.md).

categories.purpose: Delivery of grant change and deadline reminders to the user.
categories.retention: proposed_pre_beta: 90 days from creation; suppressed/failed events with last_error retained for debugging only.
categories.delete_export: Tied to user identity; deleted or anonymised on account deletion. Notification body may echo grant/project text; contains no raw secrets or tokens.
categories.fail_closed: Outbox is at-least-once with dedupe_key; idempotent handlers (see RUNBOOK §8).

categories.purpose: Security audit trail, ingestion provenance and operational debugging.
categories.secrets_constraint: Raw capability and share tokens are NEVER stored or logged. Only domain-separated SHA-256 hashes are persisted (project_owner_capabilities.token_hash, project_share_links.token_hash). Audit event tables have no token column.
categories.retention: proposed_pre_beta: Security/audit events (project_owner_audit_events, share_audit_events) 1 year; operational logs (outbox_events, source_runs, source_records, ingestion_runs, change_events) 90 days. No raw secrets, PII beyond user_id, or capability tokens in logs.
categories.delete_export: Operational logs are system-managed, not user-exportable. Audit logs may be retained longer for incident response; anonymised after the retention window where feasible.
categories.fail_closed: On source/parser failure the affected source is marked DEGRADED, last-known-good canonical data is preserved, and destructive reconciliation is blocked (see PRIVACY.md and RUNBOOK).

categories.purpose: One-time-use 256-bit owner capability tokens and revocable read-only share tokens for project access control.
categories.secrets_constraint: CRITICAL INVARIANT: neither project_owner_capabilities nor project_share_links contains a raw 'token' column. Only token_hash is stored. Raw tokens are returned to the caller exactly once and never persisted.
categories.retention: proposed_pre_beta: capability hashes retained with the project for its lifetime; share links expire (default 30d, max 365d) and are revocable. Revoked/expired hashes retained 30 days then purged.
categories.delete_export: Capabilities are not user-exportable secrets. On project deletion, capability hash is deleted; revocation is immediate and idempotent.
categories.fail_closed: Missing/invalid capability returns 404 without disclosing project existence (see index.ts / projectAccess.ts).

categories.purpose: Application/requirement documents uploaded by the user for workspace readiness and application preparation.
categories.retention: proposed_pre_beta: retained with the workspace; purged 30 days after workspace/project deletion. R2 object stored under workspace-scoped, content-addressed or capability-scoped keys.
categories.delete_export: Owner capability gate. Deleted with the parent workspace. filename may contain PII; storage_ref is an opaque object key, not user-visible.
categories.fail_closed: Uploaded documents are validated (MIME/size/archive limits, no XXE, no auto-fetch) before storage; failures quarantine without destructive changes (see DOCUMENT_SECURITY.md).

categories.purpose: Aggregate product usage and source health metrics only; never project free-text.
categories.retention: proposed_pre_beta: NOT IMPLEMENTED in the API worker. Cloudflare send_metrics is disabled (apps/api/wrangler.jsonc send_metrics=false). In-memory ResolverMetrics (packages/applicant) is ephemeral and never persisted. No anonymous telemetry, project text, or PII is collected until explicitly designed and disclosed.
categories.delete_export: N/A — no persistent analytics store exists yet.
categories.fail_closed: Absence of analytics degrades to zero telemetry; no implicit collection. Any future analytics provider must respect a deterministic core (AI minimization section in PRIVACY.md).

invariants: Official source is the source of truth; source disappearance != cancellation.
UNKNOWN != FAIL for eligibility; ambiguous source truth does not produce destructive changes.
RAW-first: every external record is snapshotted before parsing/extraction.
Immutable canonical versions; never overwrite history.
Fail-closed on source degradation: preserve last-known-good, block destructive reconciliation.
Secrets/PII never in logs: capability and share tokens stored only as SHA-256 hashes; audit events carry no raw token.
Zero-cost fallback: semantic retrieval degrades to FTS + ontology + structured filters; analytics collection never implicitly activates.
Share links are read-only, revocable, high-entropy, noindex, and disclose only a whitelisted projection.
